english_title: Proposition 1.4: Understanding from the Dirichlet Generating Function
statement_en: If $f=g*1$, then on the level of Dirichlet generating functions one has $$L(f,s):=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{f(n)}{n^s}=\zeta(s)\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n^s},\quad \operatorname{Re}(s)>1.$$ If moreover the series $$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$$ converges absolutely, then the mean value $M(f)$ exists and equals $$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}.$$
key_techniques: mean value theorem for arithmetic functions
callout_body: 因为如果$f=g*1$，那么这个关系体现在Dirichlet生成函数上就是$$L(f,s):=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{f(n)}{n^s}=\zeta(s)\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n^s},\text{Re}(s)>1$$然后$g$满足级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$绝对收敛那么$M(f)$存在且等于$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$
